cast.name: Lord Ashcombe
cast.bio: Peer of the realm. Collects clocks and grievances.
notes: Was at the Opera until one, asleep at the Ritz before two. His valet saw a man in an English coat leave by the service door.
Left for London on the boat train of the 19th, with his trunks.
Carried the Blue Star through customs with a clear conscience, in a trunk he never packed.

cast.name: Paul Sernine
cast.bio: Rentier. Nobody has ever seen him pay for anything.
notes: A regular at the Ritz since January.
Slept at the Ritz on the night of 11 January, when Mr. Blakeney did.

cast.name: Horace Velmont
cast.bio: Painter of society portraits. Paints mostly at night.
notes: Seldom in his suite after dark.
Out from 02:30 to 05:55 on the night of the theft, painting the Prefect's wife. The Prefect confirms it, twice.

cast.name: Raul Ortega
cast.bio: Cattle baron. Signs everything with a flourish and an R.
notes: Complains that the Ritz desk keeps mixing up his wires with another guest's, who also signs R.
Wired Buenos Aires from the Ritz desk at 06:20 on the 18th: morning, by Ganimard's clock.
Drinks champagne before dawn, but only after his coffee.

cast.name: Ines de Almagro
cast.bio: Widow. Never travels without her maid.
notes: A regular at the Ritz since January, never without her maid.
Slept at the Ritz on the night of 11 January, when Mr. Blakeney did.

cast.name: Rupert Blakeney
notes: His first order before dawn on the 18th: champagne, as always.
Wears an excellent coat, the kind a booking clerk remembers.
At the Ritz every other week since January, never on the same nights as Mr. Grey.
His suite was silent from 02:05 to 03:10 on the night of the theft.

wrong_suspects.paul sernine: An anagram, Ganimard? Lupin is vain, not stupid. Sernine is released with apologies.
wrong_suspects.horace velmont: Velmont went out after the lift the porter heard, to paint the Prefect's wife until dawn. The Prefect confirms it, twice.
wrong_suspects.raul ortega: Senor Ortega produces a receipt for the champagne and a lawyer for everything else.
wrong_suspects.ines almagro: The Senora faints. The maid does not. Neither is Lupin.
wrong_suspects.ashcombe: You arrest the peer in the neighbouring suite. He is the Prefect's cousin. Awkward.
wrong_suspects.arsene lupin: Yes. Under which name? That is rather the question.
wrong_suspects.grey: Mr. Grey checked out this morning. The concierge is certain, because Mr. Grey tipped him.
wrong_suspects.ganimard: The inspector reads your note, takes off his hat, and puts it back on. 'Out.'

wrong_default: Ganimard reads your note twice and lights his pipe. 'No.'
The clerk before you was dismissed for less. Try again.
Not that, mon petit. Look at the data again.

chapters.title: The Night Manager
chapters.story:
*June, four in the morning, the Prefecture.* The Ritz file is still open on **Ganimard**'s desk, and now the *Hotel Meurice* has been burgled. He drops a stack of police reports on your desk: *every theft, fraud and lost umbrella in Paris this spring.*

*'**One of these is the Meurice**, clerk. **Hippolyte Morand**, the night manager, found the damage himself. His clocks and ours have never agreed, so he will swear to the night only to within a day. And mind what he says it was not.'*
chapters.objective: The Meurice night manager knows when, give or take a day.
chapters.telegram: MY DEAR GANIMARD STOP NOT ME THIS TIME STOP I HAVE A FRIEND WITH THE SAME TASTE IN ROOMS STOP A L

chapters.title: Below the Royal Pair
chapters.story:
**Ganimard** reads the Meurice report you found and swears, once. *'A friend, he says. Lupin has no friends, clerk, only names. He has habits, though. What he did at the Meurice in June, he had done at the Ritz in May: the same floor, the same taste in rooms.'*

The Ritz has sent over its *register*: every guest, every suite and every price since January. *'On that floor, the two dearest suites share one price: the royal pair. He never touches those. Find me **the one just below the royal pair**, the night of the 17th of May.'*
chapters.objective: The report from chapter 1 describes his room. Which suite was it at the Ritz, the night of the 17th of May?
chapters.telegram: MY DEAR GANIMARD STOP MY FRIEND NEVER WALKS STOP THE RIVAL COMPANY KEEPS BETTER BOOKS THAN YOURS STOP A L

chapters.title: A Plate in the Dark
chapters.story:
Whoever slept in that room did not leave on foot. **Ganimard** has found a second cab book: a rival company, which writes down its fares as carefully as the first and trusts its drivers less.

Its despatcher, **Firmin Lagarde**, has already talked to the inspector. *'He is sure of how the plate began, and of one figure near the end. Read what he said, then find me **the cab that took him**.'*
chapters.objective: The rival despatcher is sure of two figures of the plate. Find the cab.
chapters.telegram: MY DEAR GANIMARD STOP THE CAB SMELLED OF CIGARS STOP THE DRIVER KNOWS THE WAY STOP HE HAS TAKEN ME THERE BEFORE STOP READ HIS WEEK STOP A L

chapters.title: The Cab's Week
chapters.story:
**Ganimard** taps the plate you found in chapter 3. *'A second cab book, clerk, and a driver paid to forget. But his company pays him to write it all down.'*

The book holds that cab's fares for the week of the theft, from the 13th to the 19th of May. *'A wedding brings a cab back to one door again and again in a single afternoon. A fence brings it back day after day. Find me **the address it went back to on three different days**.'*
chapters.objective: Where did the cab from chapter 3 keep going back to, the week of the theft?
chapters.telegram: MY DEAR GANIMARD STOP THREE DAYS AT THE SAME DOOR STOP FIVE TENANTS AND A CONCIERGE WHO SEES NOTHING STOP A L

chapters.title: The Boarding House
chapters.story:
The address is a boarding house: five tenants, and a concierge who has *minded her own business since the Commune*.

One of the tenants is a jeweller, and **Ganimard** could not care less. *'Every fence in Paris calls himself a jeweller, clerk, so ours calls himself nothing at all. He came to the police before we came to him: find me **the tenant who gave us a statement**.'*
chapters.objective: Who is the fence at the address from chapter 4?
chapters.telegram: MY DEAR GANIMARD STOP HE BANKS AT THE SOCIETE GENERALE STOP A TIDY MAN PAYS IN TIDY SUMS STOP A L

chapters.title: Follow the Francs
chapters.story:
The fence banks at the *Societe Generale*, and **Ganimard**'s warrant opens that ledger: one line per transfer, the account that paid, the account that was paid, the sum and the day.

*'A tidy man, clerk. No three pieces for him: he paid his man in **two equal halves** in May, the same to the franc. Not two different sums, and not three.'*
chapters.objective: Which account did the fence from chapter 5 pay in two equal halves in May?
chapters.telegram: MY DEAR GANIMARD STOP TWO HALVES TO THE FRANC STOP YOU ARE LEARNING STOP HIS BROKER CONFIRMED IT FROM THE BOURSE STOP A L

chapters.title: The Busiest Hour
chapters.story:
The money was confirmed by wire, through a broker at the *Bourse*. **Anatole Brissac** signs every wire he sends, and the Bourse telegraph office sent dozens on the 18th.

The Bourse keeps its own hours, and **Ganimard** boxes its day its own way:

| Box | From | Before |
| Before the bell | 00:00 | 10:00 |
| The session | 10:00 | 15:00 |
| The call | 15:00 | 17:00 |
| After hours | 17:00 | midnight |

*'A broker hides in a crowd, clerk. He wired in three of those boxes that day, and his real wire went out in **the busiest box**, the one with the most wires.'*
chapters.objective: Find the broker's wire in the Bourse's busiest box.
chapters.telegram: MY DEAR GANIMARD STOP YOU READ HIS WIRE STOP A MAN OF HABIT IS A MAN WITH A ROOM NUMBER STOP A L

chapters.title: The Last Order Before Dawn
chapters.story:
**Ganimard** reads aloud the broker's wire you found in chapter 7. It names his habit before dawn, *as always*.

*'A broker who sells a stolen stone sleeps near it, clerk. That night he slept at the Ritz, and room service writes down every order, in order. I want the suite where it was **the last order before dawn**. And before dawn, at my age, means before six.'*
chapters.objective: The wire from chapter 7 names his habit. Which suite had it as its last order before dawn on the 18th?
chapters.telegram: MY DEAR GANIMARD STOP GARE DU NORD NINE FIFTEEN STOP DO NOT BE LATE STOP THE BLUE STAR SENDS REGARDS FROM LONDON STOP A L
